reviews.text: Food 10/10. Reservation system 0/10 — you have to DM them on Instagram ([handle]) and pray.
Loved the part where they lost our booking and then acted like we'd made it up. Very welcoming.
The owner answered my review and invited us back. Classy.
Menu online is from 2023, prices went up about 30% since.
Server didn't speak English at all and the menu was French only. We pointed at things.
Waited 25 min for the bill. Card machine 'didn't work', so cash it was.

reviews.evidence: Excellent dishes, but reserving only works through social media messages with uncertain replies.
Reservation vanished and staff implied the guests had invented it.
Published menu is years old and current prices are much higher.
No English from staff and a single-language menu; ordering by gestures.
Long delay to settle up, then the card reader failed and cash was required.
